dedupe_keys.name: freetakserver open source tak server for atak wintak and itak situational awareness

description: FreeTAKServer (FTS) is an open-source Python implementation of a Team Awareness Kit (TAK) server, the back end that lets field teams using the ATAK (Android), WinTAK (Windows) and iTAK (iOS) apps share positions, markers, chat and files on a common map. It is developed by the FreeTAKTeam volunteer community and used by emergency services, search and rescue teams and hobbyists. Coverage: generic software, deployable from a multi-node installation on Amazon Web Services down to an Android edition. The server relays Cursor on Target (CoT) messages between clients, records them in a database, stores and shares data packages and images, federates two or more FTS instances, generates KML, supports SSL encryption and offers web administration, a command line and a REST API. Format and access: Python package and source code on GitHub with documentation and a public instance for testing; free. Licence: Eclipse Public License 2.0. Caveats: it aims to cover the main use cases of the official TAK server but not all of them, some plugins need access controlled by others, and the repository's last commit was in October 2024. Simulation uses: a real-time common operating picture for emergency response exercises, and a way to stream simulated unit positions into field devices during digital twin drills. Related records: Resgrid (platform-resgrid-computer-aided-dispatch) handles dispatch and resources for the same responders, and Sahana EDEN (platform-sahana-eden) manages humanitarian operations data.
